intro.title: Hi, nice to see you here!
intro.p1: I'm a Norwegian girl who has lived in Sweden for several years. I started out in health care and cleaning and studied nursing while looking for the right path.
intro.p2: As a creative soul I finally found out that web development was what I truly burned for. Folkuniversitetet's web developing program was 100% the right choice! Today I'm a newly graduated full-stack developer (2026).
intro.p3: I'm a positive and cheerful person who loves spreading joy. My years in care taught me responsibility, patience and teamwork.
intro.p4: Maybe I'll get the chance to create something and keep growing with you. It would be both a pleasure and an honour!
